name: reply
output:
Thanks for the clear report, and for including your version. We’ve identified a fix for the Stats page opening slowly when there’s about a year of history: “fix(stats): stats page slow to open with a year of history.”  

I don’t have a release version or store timing to share yet, but this is on our fix path. Thanks for sticking with Ritmo for a year and a half — that context helps confirm the issue.

— The Ritmo team
